args.body: The open-notice feed was refused at the response-size limit. Use new-notice-description-screen.json if committed and check its actual description fields and hit count. Treat matches as navigation and inspect at most two original buyer notices under the existing CANADABUYS-STANDALONE-DATA-QA-20261127 allowance. Prioritize an explicit standalone deliverable over incidental spreadsheet references. If a notice qualifies, execute the existing checker on a fictional pass and fail tied to the original acceptance criterion and prepare the private unsent response. If the coverage is insufficient, identify precisely what the saved feed covered and what original notice evidence would reopen the route. Reuse any finished result. Read back committed evidence and close under an actual valid lease with a lesson.
